item.text: The shared state now maps stopped playback or stopped broadcasts to `"not-live"`, buffering and pauses to `"grey"`, and active chunk playback to `"live"`. Playback and info transitions update a deduplicated `LivenessChanged` event, which the hook exposes to the playback UI. I’ve also wired last-chunk detection into playback completion. Next I’m checking types, lint, and the focused existing tests.

The focused type check only reports an existing unrelated error in `src/utils/notifications.ts` after the header test’s old boolean API was updated.

item.text:
Implemented unified voice broadcast liveness across playback, hooks, and header call sites. Buffering and paused playback use the grey badge; stopped playback or a stopped broadcast is not live. Added last-chunk detection and updated the related UI snapshots.

Verification: 5 focused suites passed (56 tests, 7 snapshots); ESLint, Stylelint, and `git diff --check` passed. TypeScript checking still reports an unrelated existing error at `src/utils/notifications.ts:79`.
